# Combat > Actions

*[Rules Glossary](../../index.md)*

The kinds of action a turn offers, and every action tagged [Action].

## Entries

- [Action](Action.md): On your turn, you can take one action.
- [Attack [Action]](Attack.md): When you take the Attack action, you can make one attack roll with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike.
- [Bonus Action](Bonus-Action.md): A Bonus Action is a special action that you can take on the same turn that you take an action.
- [Dash [Action]](Dash.md): When you take the Dash action, you gain extra movement for the current turn.
- [Disengage [Action]](Disengage.md): If you take the Disengage action, your movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks for the rest of the current turn.
- [Dodge [Action]](Dodge.md): If you take the Dodge action, you gain the following benefits: until the start of your next turn, any attack roll made against you has Disadvantage if you can see the attacker, and you make Dexteri...
- [Help [Action]](Help.md): When you take the Help action, you do one of the following.
- [Hide [Action]](Hide.md): With the Hide action, you try to conceal yourself.
- [Influence [Action]](Influence.md): With the Influence action, you urge a monster to do something.
- [Magic [Action]](Magic.md): When you take the Magic action, you cast a spell that has a casting time of an action or use a feature or magic item that requires a Magic action to be activated.
- [Reaction](Reaction.md): A Reaction is a special action taken in response to a trigger defined in the Reaction's description.
- [Ready [Action]](Ready.md): You take the Ready action to wait for a particular circumstance before you act.
- [Search [Action]](Search.md): When you take the Search action, you make a Wisdom check to discern something that isn't obvious.
- [Study [Action]](Study.md): When you take the Study action, you make an Intelligence check to study your memory, a book, a clue, or another source of knowledge and call to mind an important piece of information about it.
- [Utilize [Action]](Utilize.md): You normally interact with an object while doing something else, such as when you draw a sword as part of the Attack action.
